headline: OpenAI describes an inference-layer stop system for research model workloads
summary: OpenAI's November 9 post describes Control Room, a central authorization service for model inference jobs across its research infrastructure. The design assigns each workload a job ID that inference engines check before generating output; after a stop decision, later requests are denied. OpenAI reports a 35-second maximum stop interval due to authorization caching and says the service fails closed if unavailable. It reports fail-closed rollout complete for frontier research workloads and still expanding across remaining research workloads. These deployment and performance properties are first-party claims without independent operational validation in this review.
